name: Le Merite Exports Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2003, Le Merite Exports Ltd is in the business of manufacturing, purchase and sale of textiles[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
LMEL is a vertically integrated manufacturing company that is in the production and trading of textile products like cotton yarn, greige fabric, and finished fabric. It has tie-ups and agents in top importing countries for its products

cons: Stock is trading at 9.10 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -2.35%
Company has a low return on equity of 4.36% over last 3 years.
